ReviewNextRequest3.description: ReviewNextRequest2 fields plus required nullable selection_override. Explicit original, ready-alternative and continue variants share the immutable parent anchor; each kind keeps its own target/intent rules. Old request/version/hash is never re-encoded.

Source6CommonProfileContext.description: Server-derived owner and deletion generation. Incoming values are expected context only; JWT subject + active session binding authorize the request.

Source6PersonalSelectionRecord.description: Immutable one-article selection. Current article refs/settings stay pinned; next selection re-queries live eligible catalog. Ordinal is not an index into a preallocated item array. settings_snapshot is the saved preference snapshot pinned at the original selection, not an overwritten effective mode. On explicit_format_change, content_ref carries the one-time mode and format_change_source anchors saved work; copy the source followup policy. previous_selection_id is the actual stream head, not necessarily the source selection. Never update ProfileSettings.

Source6CommonSettings.description: Default original_full is not an explicit choice. Followup is null until selected; none is an explicit no-followup choice. Completed onboarding requires non-null followup. Merge chooses each explicitly chosen current-vehicle field, otherwise the target account field.

Source6PersonalCheckpointRecord.description: Pinned selection ownership/content refs must match. Main/followup asset/duration match server metadata and position<=duration; article_offer has null asset/duration and position0. Caller cannot declare completion.

Review1ResumeRef.description: listening references an unfinished checkpoint; practice references an unfinished lesson OR a completed lesson with pending_feedback_attempt_id. Reading a result is not a presentation ACK. Completion/ACK clears only a pointer still targeting that lesson.
